```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
```

## Analysis

Here we find the maximum theophylline concentration for each subject.


```{r}
Theoph |> 
    dplyr::group_by(Subject) |> 
    dplyr::summarize(cmax = max(conc)) |> 
    arrange(as.numeric(as.character(Subject))) |> 
    # knitr::kable()
    flextable::flextable()
```



## Plots

Plot 


```{r}
#| message: false
library(plotly)

Theoph |>
    group_by(Subject) |>
    plot_ly(x = ~Time, y = ~conc, type = "scatter", mode = "lines")
```
